question: What are the numeric rules and live values of HBD, savings interest, conversions, the debt-ratio limits, the Decentralized Hive Fund, custom_json and resource credits on Hive as of 2026-10-08?

findings.finding: Debt ratio and print rate: HBD held by the treasury is subtracted from the HBD supply before the HBD share of virtual supply is computed; print rate is 0 at or above the stop percent, 100% at or below the start percent, linear between.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: database.cpp 2886-2905 calculate_HBD_percent: "hbd_supply -= get_treasury().get_hbd_balance();"; 2924-2929: "if( percent_hbd >= dgp.get_hbd_stop_percent() ) dgp.set_hbd_print_rate( 0 ); else if( percent_hbd <= dgp.get_hbd_start_percent() ) dgp.set_hbd_print_rate( HIVE_100_PERCENT );"

findings.finding: Median feed is the median of the last 7*12 hourly-interval medians; a floor price forces HIVE price upward so that non-treasury HBD stays at or below 30% of combined HIVE+HBD market cap.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: database.cpp 2511-2530: "HBD_price min_price( HBD_asset( ( HIVE_100_PERCENT/HIVE_1_PERCENT - limit ) * hbd_supply.amount ), HIVE_asset( limit * dgpo.get_current_supply().amount ) ); if( min_price > fho.current_median_history ) { ... fho.current_median_history = min_price;"

findings.finding: Savings interest accrues as hbd-seconds on the savings balance and is minted as new HBD when more than 30 days have passed since the last payment, evaluated on the next savings balance change; since HF25 interest is paid only on savings.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: database.cpp 3327-3339: "const bool update_savings_hdb_balance = (_head_block_time - a.savings_hbd_last_interest_payment).to_seconds() > HIVE_HBD_INTEREST_COMPOUND_INTERVAL_SEC;" ... "interest_balance = props.issue_HBD( interest_to_pay, get_hbd_price() );"; hbd_interest.hpp: "auto interest = *hbd_seconds / HIVE_SECONDS_PER_YEAR; interest *= hbd_interest_rate; interest /= HIVE_100_PERCENT;"

findings.finding: Collateralized convert: refused while hbd_print_rate is 0; half the collateral converts immediately to HBD at the rolling minimum price minus 5%; creation is refused if it pushes the HBD share above hbd_stop_percent; the remainder of the collateral is returned after 3.5 days at the median price.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: hive_evaluator_transfer.cpp 486-: "HIVE_CHAIN_STATE_ASSERT( dgpo.get_hbd_print_rate() > 0, ... \"Creation of new HBD blocked at this time due to global limit.\" )"; "uint128_t _amount = ( uint128_t( o_amount.amount.value ) * HIVE_100_PERCENT ) / HIVE_CONVERSION_COLLATERAL_RATIO;"; "multiply_with_fee< HIVE_ASSET_NUM_HIVE >( for_immediate_conversion, fhistory.current_min_history, HIVE_COLLATERALIZED_CONVERSION_FEE )"; line 527: "HIVE_CHAIN_LIMIT_ASSERT( percent_hbd <= dgpo.get_hbd_stop_percent(), ...\"Creation of new ${hbd} violates global limit.\""

findings.finding: Savings withdrawal creates a delayed request of HIVE_SAVINGS_WITHDRAW_TIME (3 days), at most 100 pending; HIVE can go to the treasury only as HBD.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: hive_evaluator_transfer.cpp 625-641: "HIVE_CHAIN_LIMIT_ASSERT( from.savings_withdraw_requests < HIVE_SAVINGS_WITHDRAW_REQUEST_LIMIT ..."; "HIVE_CHAIN_TREASURY_ASSERT( op.amount.symbol == HBD_SYMBOL || !_db.is_treasury( op.to ), op.to, \"Can only transfer HBD to ${s}\""

findings.finding: custom_json runtime limit: JSON longer than 8192 characters is rejected.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: hive_evaluator.cpp 343-344: "HIVE_CHAIN_LIMIT_ASSERT( o.json.length() <= HIVE_CUSTOM_OP_DATA_MAX_LENGTH, o.json.length(), \"Operation JSON must be less than ${bytes} bytes.\""; protocol/hive_operations.cpp 421-434 requires num_auths > 0 and <= HIVE_MAX_AUTHORITY_MEMBERSHIP over required_auths + required_posting_auths and id.size() <= 32.

findings.finding: Witness property hbd_interest_rate is set through witness_update or witness_set_properties and the effective rate is the median over the active schedule.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: hive_evaluator.cpp 151-154 and 193: itr = o.props.find( "hbd_interest_rate" ); w.props.hbd_interest_rate = props.hbd_interest_rate;

findings.finding: The daily budget is 1% of the treasury HBD balance, prorated over the maintenance interval.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: dhf_processor.hpp 25: "const static uint32_t total_amount_divider = 100;"; dhf_processor.cpp 154: "int64_t daily_budget_limit = treasury_fund.amount.value / total_amount_divider;"

findings.finding: Proposals are paid in descending total_votes until the budget is exhausted; zero-vote proposals are skipped; a proposal whose voter has a proxy contributes the proxy account, not the voter.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: dhf_processor.cpp 188-190: "//Proposals without any votes shouldn't be treated as active if( _item.total_votes == 0 ) break;"; 202-210: "if( period_pay >= maintenance_budget_limit ) { processing( _item, maintenance_budget_limit ); break; }"; 99-102: "//If _voter has set proxy, then his votes aren't taken into consideration if( !_voter.has_proxy() ) { auto sum = _voter.get_governance_vote_power();"

findings.finding: Treasury HIVE is converted to HBD at 0.05% per hourly pass; proposal creation costs 10 HBD plus 1 HBD for each day of run time beyond 60, paid into the treasury; update_proposal cannot raise daily pay or extend the end date.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: dhf_processor.cpp 343: "const auto to_convert = HIVE_PROPOSAL_CONVERSION_RATE * treasury_account.get_hive_balance() / HIVE_100_PERCENT;"; dhf_evaluator.cpp 44-53 and 120-132: "HIVE_CHAIN_LIMIT_ASSERT( o_daily_pay <= proposal.daily_pay, o_daily_pay, \"You cannot increase the daily pay\" )"

findings.finding: Governance vote power is own staked VESTS (net of delegation) plus proxied VESTS across the four recursion levels.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: account_object.hpp 338-342: "return std::accumulate( proxied_vsf_votes.begin(), proxied_vsf_votes.end(), get_direct_governance_vote_power() );"

item.title: HBD Stabilizer - Renewal R4-2026 (hive.blog post, DHF proposal 388, 2026-09-03)

findings.finding: The stabilizer sells HBD above the $1 target; above $1.05 it also converts HIVE into HBD; "All funds sent to the stabilizer are used exclusively for trading according to its charter, with any resulting HBD or profits returned to the Decentralized Hive Fund (DHF)." Renewal for two months at the same DHF funding to @hbdstabilizer.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: When HBD trades above the $1 target, the stabilizer sells HBD to bring the price down, often generating profit for the community. If HBD exceeds $1.05, it also converts HIVE into HBD, removing HIVE from circulation while creating additional HBD that can potentially be sold for profit.

item.title: Proposal to make HBD interest payable only to savings accounts (hive.blog, 2021-04-15)

findings.finding: In April 2021 HBD paid 3% set by the witness median; the post proposes raising it to 10-20% once the upside peg is secured by the hardfork 25 conversion.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Hive dollars (HBD), which pay an interest rate set by the median value voted on by witnesses. But currently Hive dollars pay a relatively low interest rate of 3%

item.title: Why I set my witness HBD interest rate parameter to 7% (hive.blog, 2021-06-02)

findings.finding: By June 2021 the witness initiative begun about three months earlier had moved the parameter from 3% to 7%; the author argues 7% is sustainable.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: I believe a 7% rate is compelling, while remaining sustainable in the sense that a Hive that succeeds long term will grow its value by much more than 7%/year.

item.title: gtg witness update, upcoming changes in HBD APR (hive.blog, 2023-08-24)

findings.finding: The witness gtg announced 20% APR in April 2022 and on 2023-08-24 announced he would lower his hbd_interest_rate vote to 10% gradually; his current on-chain vote is 1000.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: In April 2022 I published a witness update, announcing 20% APR for HBD ... I will start lowering down the `hbd_interest_rate` to 10% gradually.

findings.finding: By August 2024 the rate had been paid at 20% for two to three years and witnesses were discussing 15% or less; the author estimates 20% APR at about 1.5M HBD/year added inflation and 15% at about 1.1M.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: For 2-3 years we have been paying 20% on a sustained basis and are now looking at reducing to 15% or less.

variables.q: Hive witnesses HBD savings APR change history hbd_interest_rate

searches.reading: Posts read through api.hive.blog get_content give a dated sequence of the witness-voted rate: 3% (April 2021), 7% (June 2021), 20% (April 2022, sustained two to three years), a witness reduction toward 10% announced 2023-08-24, discussion of 15% or less in August 2024, and a current median of 10%. No single first-party time series of the median was found; the sequence is assembled from four witness posts.

The hived source contains no haircut constant or function; the word appears only in libraries/protocol/words.txt. The mechanisms in source are the print-rate cut at 20%, the collateralized-convert refusal above the stop percent, and the 30% median-price floor.
